lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paaiaa vadabhaagee har ma(n)tr deeaa man thaadhe ||1||
lines.translation: I have found the Perfect Guru, through great good fortune; He has given me the Mantra of the Lord's Name, and my mind has become quiet and tranquil. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ham satigur laale kaa(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, I am the slave of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai masatak daag dagaanaa ham karaj guroo bahu saadhe ||
lines.translation: My forehead has been branded with His brand; I owe such a great debt to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paraupakaar pu(n)n bahu keeaa bhau dutar taar paraadhe ||2||
lines.translation: He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau preet ridai har naahee tin koore gaadhan gaadhe ||
lines.translation: Those who do not have love for the Lord within their hearts, harbor only false intentions and goals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu paanee kaagad binas jaat hai tiu manamukh garabh galaadhe ||3||
lines.translation: As paper breaks down and dissolves in water, the self-willed manmukh wastes away in arrogant pride. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham jaaniaa kachhoo na jaanah aagai jiu har raakhai tiu thaadhe ||
lines.translation: I know nothing, and I do not know the future; as the Lord keeps me, so do I stand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: ham bhool chook gur kirapaa dhaarahu jan naanak kutare kaadhe ||4||7||21||59||
lines.translation: For my failings and mistakes, O Guru, grant me Your Grace; servant Nanak is Your obedient dog. ||4||7||21||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)dal kha(n)daa he ||
lines.translation: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhat likhe gur paaiaa man har liv ma(n)dal ma(n)daa he ||1||
lines.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pu(n)n vadaa he ||
lines.translation: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar da(n)daut pun vadaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat har ras saad na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)daa he ||
lines.translation: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu chalahi chubhai dukh paavahi jamakaal sahahi sir da(n)daa he ||2||
lines.translation: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan har har naam samaane dukh janam maran bhav kha(n)daa he ||
lines.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: abinaasee purakh paaiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)d brahama(n)daa he ||3||
lines.translation: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vad vadaa he ||
lines.translation: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)daa he ||4||8||22||60||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਧੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is gaR mahi har raam raai hai kichh saad na paavai dheethaa ||
lines.translation: Within this body-fortress is the Lord, the Sovereign Lord King, but the stubborn ones do not find the taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har deen daiaal anugrahu keeaa har gurasabadee chakh deethaa ||1||
lines.translation: When the Lord, Merciful to the meek, showed His Mercy, I found and tasted it, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam har keeratan gur liv meethaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Lovingly focused upon the Guru, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise has become sweet to me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar paarabraham hai mil satigur laag baseethaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Supreme Lord God, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Those who are committed to the True Guru, the Divine Intermediary, meet the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur bachan sukhaane heearai tin aagai aan pareethaa ||2||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are pleased with the Guru's Teachings - the Lord's Presence is revealed to them. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh heearaa at kathor hai tin a(n)tar kaar kareethaa ||
lines.translation: The hearts of the self-willed manmukhs are hard and cruel; their inner beings are dark.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: biseear kau bahu doodh peeaaeeai bikh nikasai phol phuleethaa ||3||
lines.translation: Even if the poisonous snake is fed large amounts of milk, it will still yield only poison. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh aan milaavahu gur saadhoo ghas garuR sabad mukh leethaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, please unite me with the Holy Guru, so that I might joyfully grind and eat the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gur ke laale gole lag sa(n)gat karooaa meethaa ||4||9||23||61||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Guru; in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the bitter becomes sweet. ||4||9||23||61||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har arath sareer ham bechiaa poore gur kai aage ||
lines.translation: For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daatai naam diRaaiaa mukh masatak bhaag sabhaage ||1||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. A very blessed and fortunate destiny is recorded upon my forehead. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam guramat har liv laage ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I am lovingly centered on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
